notes:
v1.6.3 - Mod compatibility, inspection rule fix & chat scroll
Change: all built-in mods are adapted to v1.6.x - every mod.json version now matches the game build, and the 5 reskin mods (Cyberpunk / Medieval / Steampunk / Starlight / Arcane) add bilingual names and colors for the new Bribe Pot "POT" goods.
Change: inspection rule - when a merchant lies, legal goods that do not match the declared type are now detained but not fined; contraband and royal goods are still confiscated with a fine, and matching legal goods still pass.
Fix: pasting an IP address no longer appends extra characters - Ctrl+V replaces the whole field and strips BOM/whitespace/newlines from the clipboard.
Fix: the chat log can now be scrolled back from anywhere in the game screen and has a draggable scroll bar; touchpad fractional wheel input no longer breaks rendering.
Fix: GUI polish - cleaned up overlapping text/buttons and a few layout issues.

v1.6.2 - Update fixes: correct Chinese changelog & reliable restart
Fix: the in-game update log (home screen "What's New" and the update page) showed question marks for v1.6.0/v1.6.1 - the published manifest had corrupted Chinese text. The manifest is now regenerated cleanly and the changelog renders with proper line breaks.
Fix: after an update finished, the first launch could fail with "Failed to load Python DLL ... python312.dll" and the game would not restart. The update build no longer uses UPX compression (a known cause of antivirus / Smart App Control interfering with one-file extraction), the relaunch script waits for the old game process to exit, starts the new game from its own folder, verifies it actually started, and only then cleans up.

v1.6.1 - Room ready gating & join version check
New: everyone in the lobby must click Ready before the host can start the game; hosts, guests and bots all have a ready state, and the lobby shows who is ready.
New: join version check - the host now rejects clients running a different game version with a clear bilingual error (auto return to menu), so every player in a room is guaranteed to be on the same build.
Change: Market and Declare phases are now fully parallel - all merchants act at the same time instead of one by one.
Change: if a merchant rejects the sheriff's counter-offer, the merchant's original bribe offer still stands (it is no longer voided).
Fix: the lobby rename input now actually lets you change your name inside the room.
Fix: black-market quest progress is private again - other players only see claimed rewards, not your smuggled counts.
Fix: player panels no longer overlap (bagged badge vs avatar, end-game bonus text vs bot personality button).
Fix: chat history can be scrolled back with the mouse wheel; quick-chat phrases expanded to 12.
Change: pressing ESC no longer quits the game.
Fix: AI bots of the same difficulty get unique numbered names (Bot-Easy 1, Bot-Easy 2, ...).
New: stall goods are colored per goods type (colors come from the goods table, so reskin mods can change them).

v1.6.0 - Bribe bargaining
New: the bribe system now supports real negotiation. When a merchant offers a bribe, the Sheriff can counter with a higher demand instead of an immediate pass/inspect, and the merchant can accept, reject, or counter again. Each negotiation allows up to 3 counter-offers, after which only accept/reject (or pass/inspect) remain.
New: AI players (easy/normal/hard) negotiate too - sheriffs squeeze suspicious merchants for more gold, and merchants weigh the value of their smuggled goods before accepting, rejecting, or bargaining back.

v1.5.3 - Bug fixes
Fix: bots no longer freeze when you host a room - a missing argument in the AI decision code crashed the server bot thread, so bots never acted (regression from v1.5.0).
Fix: the home screen "What's New" panel showed English text with square boxes - update notes now follow the UI language and no longer render carriage-return characters.
Fix: the home screen avatar bar was squished with overlapping text - avatar preview layout reworked.

v1.5.2 - UI polish and home-screen redesign
Mods list and Mod Market are now scrollable, so many mods are fully visible.
Home screen redesigned: grouped Settings / Avatar / Tools cards, fixed paste & avatar-path input positions, scrollable "What's New" panel shows the latest update notes.
Lobby: new scrollable panel lists installed gameplay-rule mods with descriptions and categories.
Room settings renamed "Rounds" to "Turns" (it is the number of turns, not rounds).
"Leave Room" now returns to the main menu instead of quitting the game.

v1.5.1 - Fixed: "Update & Restart" did nothing (from v1.4)
Fix: an interrupted update used to leave a pending flag in %TEMP%\SheriffUpdate; after that every click silently "succeeded" without installing. The flag now records the batch process id and is auto-cleared when stale, so updates always re-run.
Fix: the background update script now writes update.log / inno_install.log and, if the silent install still fails, opens the GitHub releases page as a fallback.
Improvement: the installer now defaults to a per-user folder, so silent auto-updates never need an admin elevation prompt.
GUI: home screen grouped panels, lobby sections, update changelog panel, 6 new rule mods + mod compatibility checks, bot personalities (from v1.5.0).
notes_zh:
v1.6.3 - 模组兼容适配、查验规则修正与聊天滚动
改动：全部内置模组已适配新版本——所有模组版本号与游戏版本对齐，5 个换皮模组（赛博朋克/中世纪/蒸汽朋克/星辉/奥术）补齐了贿赂陶罐新增货物 POT 的中英文名称与专属配色。
改动：查验规则修正——商人谎报时，与申报种类不符的合法货物仅被扣留、不再罚款；违禁品与皇家货物仍照旧没收并罚款，与申报一致的合法货物照常放行。
修复：复制粘贴 IP 不再多出多余字符——Ctrl+V 改为整字段替换，并自动清理剪贴板中的 BOM、空白与换行。
修复：聊天记录现在可以在游戏画面任意位置用鼠标滚轮回看，并新增可拖拽滚动条；触摸板小数滚轮不再导致渲染异常。
修复：GUI 逻辑与排版优化，修正若干文字/按钮重叠与布局问题。

v1.6.2 - 更新修复：正确的中文更新日志与可靠的重启
修复：游戏内更新日志（首页"最新更新"与更新页面）在 v1.6.0/v1.6.1 中显示为问号——发布清单里中文字段被损坏。现已重新生成干净的中文内容，日志按段落正确换行排版。
修复：更新完成后首次启动可能报 "Failed to load Python DLL ... python312.dll" 导致无法重启。更新包不再使用 UPX 压缩（杀毒软件/智能应用控制干扰单文件解压的常见诱因）；重启脚本会先等待旧游戏进程退出，再从游戏自身目录启动新版本，确认启动成功后才清理临时文件。

v1.6.1 - 房间准备机制与加入版本校验
新增：大厅内所有玩家必须先点击"准备"才能开局；房主、客人、人机都有准备状态，大厅会显示谁已准备。
新增：加入房间版本校验——版本不一致的客户端会被房主拒绝并给出中英双语提示（自动返回主菜单），保证同一房间的玩家都是同一版本。
改动：市场与申报阶段改为全并行——所有商人同时行动，无需轮流等待。
改动：商人拒绝警长的还价后，仍然按第一次贿赂的出价生效（不再作废）。
修复：大厅内的改名输入框现在真正可用。
修复：黑市任务进度恢复保密——其他人只能看到已领取的奖励，看不到你的走私数量。
修复：玩家面板不再重叠（封袋标记与头像、终局加分文字与人机性格按钮）。
修复：聊天记录可用鼠标滚轮回看；快捷短语扩充至 12 条。
改动：按 ESC 不再退出游戏。
修复：同难度的人机会自动编号（Bot-Easy 1/2/...），易于区分。
新增：摊位货物按货物种类着色（颜色取自货物表，换皮模组可修改）。

v1.6.0 - 贿赂讨价还价
新增：贿赂系统支持真正的讨价还价。商人提出贿赂后，警长可以反还价索要更高金额，而不是立即放行/检查；商人随后可接受、拒绝或再次还价。每次谈判最多反还价 3 轮，之后只能接受/拒绝（或放行/检查）。
新增：人机（简单/普通/困难）也会讨价还价——警长人机会向可疑商人索要更多金币，商人会权衡袋中走私品价值后再决定接受、拒绝或还价。

v1.5.3 - 问题修复
修复：自己开房后人机不再卡死——AI 决策代码缺少一个参数导致服务器人机线程崩溃、人机全程不行动（v1.5.0 引入的回归）。
修复：首页"最新更新"面板曾显示英文与方框——更新说明现在跟随界面语言，且不再渲染回车符导致的方框。
修复：首页头像栏曾缩在一起、文字重叠——重新调整头像预览布局。

v1.5.2 - 界面优化与首页改版
模组管理与模组市场现在支持滚动，模组再多也能全部看到。
首页改版：设置 / 头像 / 工具三栏卡片布局，修复粘贴与头像路径输入框位置，底部新增可滚动的"最新更新"面板展示更新内容。
大厅：新增可滚动栏位，列出已启用的玩法模组及其说明与分类。
房间设置中"轮数"更名为"回合数"（实际是回合数）。
"退出房间"现在返回主菜单，不再直接退出游戏。

v1.5.1 - 修复："更新并重启"无反应（自 v1.4 起）
修复：中断的更新曾在 %TEMP%\SheriffUpdate 残留标记，之后每次点击都静默"成功"却不安装。标记现在会记录批处理进程 ID，过期自动清理，更新始终会重新执行。
修复：后台更新脚本现在写入 update.log / inno_install.log，若静默安装仍失败，会打开 GitHub Releases 页面作为兜底。
改进：安装程序默认安装到当前用户目录，静默自动更新不再需要管理员权限弹窗。
界面：首页分组面板、大厅分区、更新日志面板、6 个新玩法模组与兼容性检查、人机性格（来自 v1.5.0）。
